top_signal.title: I started my own footwear brand in India, but I'm struggling to get orders. What am I doing wrong?
top_signal.summary: Hey everyone,   I'm a small business owner from India, and I'm trying to build my own footwear brand called Flipoza. I sell slippers, slides, and clogs on Amazon and Flipkart.   I'm doing almost everything myself — product sourcing, listings, product photos, pricing, and marketing. I genuinely try to offer good-quality products at a reasonable price, and I'm putting a lot of time and effort into this business.   But honestly, I'm struggling.   Despite all the work, I'm not getting the number of orders I expected. I even hired a company to help me grow my sales, hoping they could bring some results, but they couldn't generate even a single order.   As a small seller, spending money without getting results is really frustrating. I don't have a huge budget, so every expense matters.   I'm not here to complain or promote my brand. I genuinely want to understand what I'm doing wrong.   For those who have experience selling physical products online, especially on Amazon, Flipkart, or other marketplaces:   - Is the main problem usually product demand, pricing, listing quality, or visibility?   - How can a new brand compete with established brands when it has very few reviews?   - If you were starting a footwear brand from scratch today, what would you focus on first?   - How would you figure out whether a product is worth continuing with before spending more money on ads or agencies?   I'd really appreciate honest advice, even if it's something I might not want to hear.   I'm willin
